description: This source file defines the LongFreeTextDatatype class, a custom data type for OpenMRS that handles long free-text input stored as a CLOB in the database. It implements methods for saving, referencing, and validation of the datatype.

classes.name: LongFreeTextDatatype
classes.description: A custom datatype class for handling long free-text data in OpenMRS, stored as a CLOB in the database.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets configuration options for the datatype; no options are used in this implementation.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the given string value into the database, creating or updating a ClobDatatypeStorage and returning its UUID.

methods.name: getReferenceStringForValue
methods.description: Returns the reference string for the value; unsupported in this datatype, throws exception.

methods.name: fromReferenceString
methods.description: Retrieves the actual long text value from its reference UUID.

methods.name: getTextSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary or placeholder message for the stored value.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input value, ensuring it is not null.
